import bpy, os, tempfile, base64
from mathutils import Vector
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected: raise RuntimeError('arquivo errado')
s=bpy.context.scene; terrain=bpy.data.objects['WORLD | TERRENO MASTER | blockout']; low=bpy.data.collections['D | ESTACAO CIDADE BAIXA | blockout v1']
state=(s.camera,s.render.engine,s.render.resolution_x,s.render.resolution_y,s.render.resolution_percentage,s.render.image_settings.file_format,s.render.image_settings.quality,s.render.filepath,terrain.hide_render,terrain.hide_viewport)
s.render.engine='BLENDER_WORKBENCH'; s.render.resolution_x=200; s.render.resolution_y=150; s.render.resolution_percentage=100; s.render.image_settings.file_format='JPEG'; s.render.image_settings.quality=18
try:
 s.display.shading.light='STUDIO'; s.display.shading.color_type='MATERIAL'; s.display.shading.show_shadows=True; s.display.shading.show_cavity=True
except: pass
cd=bpy.data.cameras.new('QA_FRONT'); cam=bpy.data.objects.new('QA_FRONT',cd); s.collection.objects.link(cam); s.camera=cam; cd.lens=45; cd.clip_end=2000
def pts(c):
 out=[]
 for o in c.all_objects:
  if o.type in {'MESH','FONT'}:
   try: out += [o.matrix_world@Vector(x) for x in o.bound_box]
   except: pass
 return out
def enc(tag):
 p=os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(),tag+'.jpg'); s.render.filepath=p; bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True); d=open(p,'rb').read(); os.remove(p); return base64.b64encode(d).decode('ascii')
allp=pts(low); center=Vector((sum(p.x for p in allp)/len(allp),sum(p.y for p in allp)/len(allp),sum(p.z for p in allp)/len(allp)))
doors=[o for o in low.objects if 'porta ' in o.name.lower() and o.type=='MESH']
dp=[]
for o in doors: dp += [o.matrix_world@Vector(x) for x in o.bound_box]
doorc=Vector((sum(p.x for p in dp)/len(dp),sum(p.y for p in dp)/len(dp),sum(p.z for p in dp)/len(dp)))
front=Vector((doorc.x-center.x,doorc.y-center.y,0)).normalized()
try:
 # fachada limpa
 terrain.hide_render=True
 cam.location=doorc+front*24+Vector((0,0,5.2)); target=doorc+Vector((0,0,.35)); cam.rotation_euler=(target-cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler(); print('F='+enc('qa_front_correct'))
 # implantação com terreno
 terrain.hide_render=False
 cam.location=center+front*38+Vector((18,-12,24)); target=center+Vector((0,0,1)); cam.rotation_euler=(target-cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler(); cd.lens=38; print('P='+enc('qa_place_correct'))
 print('FRONT='+repr(tuple(round(x,4) for x in front))+' DOOR_CENTER='+repr(tuple(round(x,2) for x in doorc)))
finally:
 s.camera,s.render.engine,s.render.resolution_x,s.render.resolution_y,s.render.resolution_percentage,s.render.image_settings.file_format,s.render.image_settings.quality,s.render.filepath,terrain.hide_render,terrain.hide_viewport=state; bpy.data.objects.remove(cam,do_unlink=True); bpy.data.cameras.remove(cd)
